crop_recommendation.title: Crop Recommendation Dataset
crop_recommendation.author: Atharva Ingle
limitations: Publisher describes augmented India rainfall, climate, and fertilizer data
N/P/K soil-lab units and rainfall aggregation period are unresolved
No farm, date, district, season, or yield outcomes for independent field validation

weather.free_api_scope: Non-commercial use, subject to provider terms
weather.advisory_thresholds: Configurable project assumptions; not official warning or crop-disease thresholds

sustainability.formula_authority: Project-defined indicative resource-use comparison; not a certification standard
limitations: No measured or causal savings established
Excludes total consumed water, biodiversity, soil health, and nutrient balance
